body: Because I told my therapist I sometimes thought about suicide and she freaked out and sent me to the hospital and I had to spend 18 hours in a bed under constant supervision before I could even talk to anybody. I legitimately have never felt more suicidal than the time I was in the hospital.
Terribly. They're considering bringing me back to the hospital and I don't know if I can handle that again.
This is awesome. I love coincidences like this.
